target_customer: Home health and hospice agencies that schedule field clinicians
problem: Home health agencies schedule clinicians manually, with poor visibility of routes, cancellations and patient ETAs, which cuts clinician productivity.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for scheduling and workforce management
product_category: Home health scheduling and workforce software

founders.name: Adam Stansell
education: Columbia, BA in Econ-Math, summa cum laude
founders.background_notes: YC page also lists management consulting and investment banking. Business Insider via search says he helped launch Uber Eats in the northeast US.

technical_complexity.rationale: Scheduling optimization with route and EMR integrations is standard engineering with some hard constraint solving; HIPAA compliance adds overhead.

defensibility.rationale: EMR integrations and embedded scheduling workflows create switching costs, though large EMR vendors could add scheduling.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The Axle site lists integrations with WellSky and Netsmart EMRs; no source shows them copying or buying Axle.

market_need_then: Home health staffing shortage and scheduling inefficiency; the seed press release (Feb 2024) frames the need as staffing shortage. No 2021 dated demand source found.

identity.logo: Axle Health wordmark in dark and light versions
identity.voice_and_tone: Operational and outcome focused, for example Optimize every minute of home health care

branding.community_and_virality: Podcast and newsletter interviews of the CEO exist (Pear Healthcare Playbook, Slice of Healthcare); no merch or community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Plain functional name with healthcare press from funding news but no sign the brand itself drove growth.

pivots.to: SaaS model for home health scheduling
pivots.why: AIM Research headline says Axle pivoted to a SaaS model with its Series A; the article was not opened, so details are unverified.

outcome_analysis: Axle Health raised a 4.2 million dollar seed in February 2024 and a 10 million dollar Series A in May 2025 led by F-Prime, and reports 900 percent growth over its 2024 fiscal year (company reported). Focus on a narrow home health scheduling wedge and EMR integrations supported fundraising. Still independent with no exit found.
notes: Seed lead conflicts: HomeCare Magazine and HLTH say Pear VC led, HIT Consultant says TRAC VC led. Company said total raised was $4.4M after the seed, implying about $0.2M earlier (likely YC), not recorded as a round. Persana lists a $2.5M 2021 seed and a $1.6M 2024 round that conflict and are unverified. Seedtable lists Pear VC as Series A lead, conflicting with F-Prime in most sources. CB Insights total $14.33M over 6 rounds vs $10M at VC Backed. One profile names Connor Hailey as co-founder; not on the YC page, so not recorded. Competitors empty: only undated aggregator lists (AlayaCare, WellSky, Netsmart, AxisCare, HomeCare HomeBase) were found, none dated near 2021. Outcome search found no acquisition, shutdown or layoffs.
